# Forhemit

> Forhemit helps founders sell their business to their employees — 100% employee ownership (ESOP) succession at full price, on a four-month path. Founded 2026, based in San Francisco, serving founders nationally.

## Who it is for

Founders of profitable, founder-led companies with $3M+ revenue and 20+ verifiable U.S. employees, who hold 51% or more and can be available for 4 to 12 months after close, on call. And the brokers, attorneys, CPAs, and wealth managers who advise them.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.forhemit.com/): Sell your business to your employees.
- [About](https://www.forhemit.com/about): Who Forhemit is — Stefano Stokes, Founder & CEO, one accountable lead.
- [For Business Owners](https://www.forhemit.com/business-owners): Who qualifies, how the Section 1042 tax-deferred treatment works, and what life looks like after close.
- [The Four-Month Path](https://www.forhemit.com/four-month-path): How the transition works month by month, and the money in plain terms.
- [Pricing](https://www.forhemit.com/pricing): The Self Guided Transition Service ($3,000 one-time) and Custom Services (total transition fees 3–5% of valuation). Payment only after an approved application.
- [Insights](https://www.forhemit.com/blog): Essays — The Exit Crisis and Beyond the Balance Sheet.
- [FAQ](https://www.forhemit.com/faq): Answers for owners, brokers, attorneys, CPAs, and wealth managers.
- [Contact](https://www.forhemit.com/contact): Start with the free 2-Minute Check.
